method: Read prior retained originals and provenance; independently verified native source image equality, PDF structural facts, and visually inspected all three logo specimens and PDF cover. Fresh web searches with two search engines for designer/logo/original name found no stronger image or vector.
limits: Fresh Wayback/CDX request returned HTTP 503 and web open could not access archived pages. Original retained files and their provenance were used for primary-document inspection.
Prior retained index sweep covers 27 PDF downloads (26 unique) and 149 unique pages; this turn did not redownload or reinspect every PDF, and should not claim a new exhaustive sweep.
Logo designer, initial adoption date, original colour specifications, and vector artwork remain unverified.
